name: ai-os
description: Framework + Agent Skills for a headless AI assisting system over real folders. pre-onboarding is the entry point for preparing a lived-in folder: it audits the folder and tidies it only through plans the owner approves (folder-curation, its component), extracts and summarises every document with its bundled tools, builds the wiki (wiki-onboarding, under wiki-maintenance's core wiki rule) and hands the folder to project-onboarding, which onboards cold and prepared folders in one flow. Also user-onboarding, the job-archetype framework (file-ingest, user-synthesis, code, folder-curation) and file-preprocessing: staging-folder triage with a portable hash-keyed audit manifest any agent can produce or consume. Works in any Claude Code or Cowork session, and can be consumed by an automated pipeline from the same source.
